description: This file defines the Controller class within the Opencart\System\Engine namespace. It serves as a base class for handling controller logic in the OpenCart platform, managing a registry object, and providing magic methods for property access.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Base class for controllers in the OpenCart Engine, providing registry management and magic methods for property access.
